description: This file defines the TabController class, which manages user interface tabs, system tabs, user permissions, and settings within the SuiteCRM platform, including retrieval, setting, and restoring tab configurations.

classes.name: TabController
classes.description: Controller class for managing system and user interface tabs, including retrieval, setting, and permission management within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: is_system_tabs_in_db
methods.description: Checks if system tabs are stored in the database.

methods.name: get_system_tabs
methods.description: Retrieves the system tabs configuration, caching results for efficiency.

methods.name: get_tabs_system
methods.description: Returns current system and unset tabs, considering iframe visibility.

methods.name: set_system_tabs
methods.description: Saves the system tabs configuration to the database.

methods.name: get_users_can_edit
methods.description: Checks if users are allowed to edit their tab settings.

methods.name: set_users_can_edit
methods.description: Sets whether users can edit their tab settings, restricted to admins.

methods.name: get_key_array
methods.description: Converts an array to a key-value pair array with identical keys and values.

methods.name: get_user_tabs
methods.description: Retrieves user-specific tab preferences, defaulting to system tabs if none are set.

methods.name: get_unset_tabs
methods.description: Returns tabs not set by the user.

methods.name: get_old_user_tabs
methods.description: Retrieves legacy tab preferences for a user.

methods.name: get_old_tabs
methods.description: Returns legacy and current tab configurations for a user.

methods.name: get_tabs
methods.description: Calculates effective tabs based on user permissions and preferences.

methods.name: restore_tabs
methods.description: Restores default system tabs for a user.
